next.reason: 1985: the released record 'is no longer available in the record area unless' its file is in a SAME RECORD AREA clause, then available as a record of the other files in it. §2023:14.9.35.4 GR6 states the same ('is no longer available in the record area unless file-name-1 or the file-name associated with record-name-1 is specified in a SAME RECORD AREA clause'; file-name-1 serves only the new FILE phrase), and §2023:14.9.35.4 GR10 restates the unavailability ('the information in the area referenced by record-name-1 is not available except as specified for the SAME RECORD AREA clause'). Run-time rule, no refusal moved.
